description: This Java class implements shipping quote integration with Canada Post API. It constructs XML requests, sends HTTP POST requests, parses XML responses, and provides shipping options based on the API response. It also validates the module configuration and handles errors.

classes.name: CanadaPostShippingQuote
classes.description: Main class implementing the ShippingQuoteModule interface for Canada Post integration. Handles configuration validation, request creation, API communication, response parsing, and error logging.

classes.name: CanadaPostParsedElements
classes.description: Helper class to hold parsed elements from the Canada Post API response, including status codes, messages, and list of shipping options.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the integration configuration contains necessary keys and options, such as 'account' and 'packages'.

methods.name: getShippingQuotes
methods.description: Constructs and sends an XML request to the Canada Post API, parses the XML response, handles errors, and returns a list of available shipping options.

methods.name: getCustomModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Returns null as there is no custom configuration for this module.
